About Us
A premier manufacturer and supplier of leather safety goods based in Savar, Hemayetpur, Bangladesh. Committed to delivering high-quality personal protective equipment and reliable service to global partners.
Who We Are

Experience, capacity and quality in every glove.

Max Gloves BD Ltd. is a dedicated manufacturer and supplier of leather safety goods based in Savar, Hemayetpur, Bangladesh. Guided by our core commitment—Protecting Hands, Building Futures—we provide workers worldwide with dependable, high-performance personal protective equipment.

Our production facility in Savar, Hemayetpur specializes in industrial safety gloves, heavy-duty welding articles, and driver gloves engineered for maximum durability, ergonomics, and comfort.

We maintain rigorous quality control across every stage of manufacturing—from raw leather grading and automated precision cutting to reinforced stitching and pre-shipment inspections.

Customer service and consistent high-quality supply are our highest priorities. We provide professional, responsive service and customized OEM/ODM glove solutions tailored to the needs of our international partners.

We record and track leather quality, inventory, and production data so that every glove batch meets strict safety standards before export.

Our team manages international orders efficiently, providing transparent communication and reliable fulfillment to customers across the globe.

100% Quality Commitment
Premium Leather Selection
Export Standard Compliance
Global Delivery Capability
Our Vision

Responsible growth with a global purpose.

Our vision focuses on minimizing supply chain delays and delivering consistent excellence. By sourcing high quality raw materials and working with dependable local tanneries, we ensure stable production timelines and cost efficiency.

Located strategically in Savar, Hemayetpur, Bangladesh, our facility benefits from excellent transportation links to Dhaka international airport and direct highway routes to major seaport hubs, enabling smooth logistics for air and sea freight.

As a company, our goal is to become an indispensable partner in hand safety across global industries. We continually optimize patterns, reinforced palms, and stitching methods to create gloves that protect lives in tough working conditions.

We believe that with the right partners, Max Gloves BD Ltd. can advance the rapidly growing PPE industry.

Domestic & Global SourcingDependable supply chain foundation.
Efficient LogisticsStreamlined transit to airport and sea shipping hubs.
Continuous InnovationImproving glove ergonomics, protection, and durability.
Global Safety AmbitionProtecting hands and building futures everywhere.
